reason: [GPT-6-ASTRA] #6435 intentionally changes the always-compiled engine bind-join path: verified sorted groups carry contiguous ranges instead of an allocated identity-index vector. A new inline sparq-substrate::join::bind_combine_rows helper combines row slices and shares a private row emitter with the unchanged indexed bind_combine API. The default sparq-wasm build consumes this code. Existing sortedness validation, hash fallback, scans, filters, budgets, zk accumulation and output sorted_by contract remain intact. Local single-host advisory default release-wasm builds (host aarch64-apple-darwin, pinned Rust 1.97.1) measured landed main 60e3f84c1e9ef2dc6a9352a131e825d3e60894c1 at 1560265 bytes and implementation 2a1caceebd85b03cbd5f7d4542ee8698d65cd7f4 at 1559117 bytes (-1148). These byte counts are descriptive local observations, not parsed size requirements. This is an intentional default-path change. The independent wasm_bundle_bytes floor 1587594 and threshold 0.02 are unchanged. Native allocation measurements show removal of the identity vector; peak live bytes are unchanged, their peak location was not profiled, and no query latency improvement is claimed.
